# WAR! What is it good for?? KMs and Content obviously

Welcome to the War Report! Tracking a war in space? Hit the **War** button, set up the two sides and a start date, and GoSleuth follows the fighting between them. A side can be one corp or alliance, or a Coalition, a new feature found under My Intel. Got a saved EVE Tools battle report? Paste it in and both sides are read from it.

Your report grows every time you hit Update, and it pulls killmails smartly: it only reads what's new, and it keeps what it has even after zKillboard's limit has moved past them. Station trash and asset denial are sorted out from the fights, and citadels under attack are marked. There's also a Timeline, plus tabs for who fought and in what.

Review the battles, split them into several, merge others together, and ignore what doesn't belong. Add notes, and nickname systems to keep things clear.

When you want to share it and boost your side's morale, hit **Generate Report** for a handy HTML file. Your notes and nicknames go with it, so check them before you post it!

Killmails can't show objectives or survivors, so GoSleuth never calls a battle won. That's for you to decide.

Coalitions can also be searched as one target, and the search bar has new `a:`, `c:`, and `w:` tags for finding your affiliate groups, coalitions, and wars.

[The full guide to the War Report](https://github.com/lynkfox/eve-gosleuth/blob/main/docs/war_report.md)
